content.text: Real-Time Dashboard-specific visuals in Real-Time Dashboards adds dedicated capabilities for navigating, comparing, and customizing time-based data, including a legend search bar, pin-and-overlay for series comparison, multiple aligned-time panels, flexible Y-axis scaling, color assignment, and zoom with a time slider.
